$comment: Champion stun-type counters: which subclass verbs stun each champion type, in addition to seasonal artifact mods and intrinsic breaker-type weapons.

entries.notes: While Radiant, all your weapons pierce Barrier Champion shields.
Volatile rounds pierce Barrier Champion shields.
Unraveling rounds pierce Barrier Champion shields.
Jolting an Overload Champion stuns it.
Suppressing an Overload Champion stuns it.
Slowing an Overload Champion interrupts and stuns it.
An Ignition staggers an Unstoppable Champion.
Suspending an Unstoppable Champion stuns it.
Blinding an Unstoppable Champion staggers it.
Freezing then Shattering an Unstoppable Champion stuns it.
Weapons with intrinsic Shield-Piercing or the seasonal artifact anti-barrier perk.
Weapons with intrinsic Disruption or the seasonal artifact overload perk.
Weapons with intrinsic Stagger or the seasonal artifact unstoppable perk.
